per_hop.query:
SELECT 
  ps.position AS philip_savage_position,
  ps.team AS team,
  gm.name AS general_manager,
  gm.draft_position AS gm_draft_position,
  sl.name AS steve_little,
  sl.draft_position AS steve_little_draft_position,
  gm.college_football_hof_inducted,
  gm.pro_football_hof_inducted
FROM personnel ps
JOIN general_managers gm ON gm.team = ps.team AND gm.tenure_start <= ps.tenure_start AND gm.tenure_end >= ps.tenure_end
JOIN players sl ON sl.name = 'Steve Little'
WHERE ps.name = 'Philip Savage'
  AND ps.position = 'Director of Player Personnel'
  AND ps.team = 'Baltimore Ravens';

Did Philip Savage serve as Director of Player Personnel for the Baltimore Ravens under General Manager Ozzie Newsome, who was drafted lower than Steve Little and inducted into both the College and Pro Football Halls of Fame?
